sources.title: Physical Layer Simplified Specification
sections: 4.4 clock control while ACMD41 is pending
4.2 initialization clock range and completion timing

scope: Source-bound metadata codec, one-shot query, bounded wire parser and native SPI3 diagnostic transport; not linked into the image and never run on hardware.

diagnostic_policies.ocr_policy: Require overlap with3.2-3.4V nominal window; not a measured-rail or full-tolerance acceptance test.
diagnostic_policies.sdhc_sdxc_capacity: Reported CSDv2 bit-field capacity only, not a full SD conformance test.
diagnostic_policies.unknown_csd: Preserve raw response and reject unsupported structures; SDUC is not SPI-compatible.
diagnostic_policies.cmd0: Changes protocol state and can interrupt pending programming. Portable query requires exclusive cold-start declaration exactly1, does not prove actual ownership and has no reset/retry after failure.
diagnostic_policies.query_deadlines: Engineering bench policies checked at subsequent polls. Cannot preempt a callback that never returns. The native port uses finite MMIO polling budgets, not measured wall-clock execution limits.

open_items: Image scheduling, global clock/ownership policy, capture record and host report integration are unimplemented. The current ABI5 image does not initialize SPI3 or send these commands.
Actual card electrical behavior, SCK/CS timing and post-EOT guard, execution time, physical ownership, card insertion/retention, power-loss/endurance and logging throughput remain unqualified.
No connection or protocol command was sent to a real card. No media block read, write, erase, lock or format path is provided.

native_policies.clock: Require HSI64 system/HCLK and CKPER=HSI/SPI123SEL=CKPER. Do not write shared clock selectors or reset SPI1. Nominal SPI3=64MHz/256=250kHz; actual clock/timing unmeasured.
native_policies.ownership: Only when query cold-start declaration is exactly1, and SPI3 enable/reset are clear. This software precondition is not an inter-core lock or proof of exclusive physical ownership. Global clock-policy integration remains open. Setup/cleanup RCC and GPIO read-modify-write updates require serialization against concurrent register mutations, even by users of other peripherals.
native_policies.gpio: PD0 CS preloaded high before output; PC10/11/12 AF6. Preserve other GPIO/RCC fields. Release parks only the three SPI pins analog/no-pull and retains PD0 high. GPIOC/D clocks remain enabled.
native_policies.transfer: 1..16 bytes; byte TXDR/RXDR; finite combined TXP/RXP/EOT polling budget. Continuous software CS across chunks. Disable/re-enable for each chunk with AFCNTR, drain RX, check late status before clearing flags.
native_policies.bound_status: Iteration/byte limits and512-loop post-EOT guard are engineering policies, not measured timing or proof of SD/silicon conformance.
native_policies.evidence: Retain full primary and cleanup port errors, register observations, bootstrap receive bytes, wire byte totals and64-byte TX/RX prefixes. Query io_detail is a truncated layered summary; retain wire.detail and native.detail separately when adding capture serialization.
native_policies.cleanup: Release only resources claimed by this port; CS high, bounded suspend, reset/readback only SPI3, disable/readback its clock, park only its SPI pins. Failed cleanup keeps ownership nonzero and prevents valid completion.
